rationale.conceptual: Standard DFT method applied to simple ionic crystals; requires understanding of plane-wave DFT, Murnaghan equation of state, and band structure extraction, but no novel algorithm development.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline with many repeated SCF calculations (6 compound-structure combos * at least 7 volumes each) plus band structure runs; requires scripting to manage inputs and parse outputs.

difficulty.reasoning: Standard DFT reproduction of structural and electronic properties of simple binary compounds; method is well-established, but requires careful multi-step workflow with equation-of-state fitting and band structure extraction.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Small unit cells (2 atoms per cell) with moderate plane-wave cutoff (~100 Ry) and k-point grid (6x6x6) result in low memory footprint; no GPU required.
